method: Computed SHA-256 hashes and byte sizes for all three supplied PDFs and compared them with the published timeline sources and evidence catalogs.
Opened, text-extracted and rendered all 66 pages in sequence; every page was readable and every first page was nonblank.
Confirmed that the J17646-1 leachate report and J17993-1 effluent report are exact byte-for-byte matches to the established site copies.

Compared the supplied J19915-1 PDF with the established 22-page site copy page by page. It is the same laboratory job, sample set, analytical tables and chain-of-custody package, but a different rendition with a horizontally clipped receipt-log page.
Kept the cleaner, complete J19915-1 site copy and reused the existing October 3, 2018, November 5, 2018 and June 4, 2019 timeline records without creating duplicate events or document records.
